skill_name: List five common treatments for depression
workflow: Common treatments for depression include psychotherapy, medication, lifestyle changes, self-help strategies, and complementary and alternative treatments. Some medications used for depression include selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), and atypical antidepressants.
